question_or_proposition: During Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive), to what extent do the Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase effluent limitations and monitoring requirements governed by footnote (*11)—including the 24,992 lbs/day 30-day average loading limit, 449 mg/L 30-day average concentration limit, and 1/Week 12-hour composite sampling—apply, as distinct from the (*10) limitations that apply during the first three years after the permit effective date?
required_context: whether the permit was administratively continued
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf Page 5 / Section part_i / table row (*11); footnote (*11)
notes: The nominated row specifies post-three-year limits tied to footnote (*11), while an adjacent row specifies different numeric limits under footnote (*10) for the initial three-year period. Resolving when (*11) limits and monitoring apply relative to FY2025 determines which enforceable numeric limits govern compliance comparisons, whether associated monitoring was required, and how to classify missing or non-numeric results for this parameter.
